title: Agent-eval export model calls section (schemaVersion 1)
description: Schema of ONE model-call record; the file calls.jsonl carries exactly one record per line (UTF-8, LF-terminated; an empty section is a zero-byte file). Honesty rules pinned here: usage prices that are unknown stay explicitly null and are marked unknown=true — a null observed price with unknown=false is a contract violation (never fabricate, never conflate with zero); reservedMicroUsd may be null even when the observed price is known. attemptId/jobId must resolve against the manifest lineage.

round.description: The actual agent-loop round the call belongs to.

reservedMicroUsd.description: Reserved budget in micro-USD, or null when not reserved.

observedMicroUsd.description: Observed spend in micro-USD, or null when the price is unknown. Unknown is null, never 0 and never fabricated.

unknown.description: true means the price is honestly unknown: observedMicroUsd must then be null.
